title: Characteristic polynomial of an endomorphism of a finite locally free module of constant rank
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, $M$ an $A$-module for which there are $f_1,\dots,f_r\in A$ generating the unit ideal with $M_{f_i}$ free of rank $n$ over $A_{f_i}$ for all $i$ ($M$ finite locally free of constant rank $n$), and $\varphi:M\to M$ an $A$-linear map. The characteristic polynomial $\mathrm{CharPol}_A(\varphi:M\to M)\in A[T]$ is the unique polynomial $\chi$ of [lem-weil-pbc-charpoly-locally-free-existence]: for every ring map $A\to A'$ with $M\otimes_AA'$ free of rank $n$ over $A'$, the image of $\chi$ in $A'[T]$ is $\det(T\cdot1-\varphi\otimes1)$ on $M\otimes_AA'$. It is of the form $T^n+c_{n-1}T^{n-1}+\dots+c_0$, and it does not depend on the choice of $f_1,\dots,f_r$ (the characterizing property does not mention them).
